concept.title: Work with bare-metal nodes
concept.shortdesc: For clusters with bare-metal nodes, you can place a node into maintenance mode, and resume a node from maintenance mode, by using the web console Actions control.

note.p: Clusters with bare-metal nodes can also place a node into maintenance mode, and resume a node from maintenance mode, by using the web console and CLI, as outlined. These methods, by using the web console Actions control, are applicable to bare-metal clusters only.
